note: What a server sends to move units along paths of its own choosing, stating how each one travels rather than leaving it to the receiving end. It is what carries a unit thrown, dragged, or carried along by something other than its own walking. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: movementCount
fields.note: How many units follow. A count above 32767 counts as none, as zero does.

fields.name: movements
fields.note: What each unit is told to do.

bits.name: hasTeleportToken
bits.note: Set where a token sits beside the unit.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: A client ignores these; a server writes zero.

bits.name: pointCount
bits.note: How many points the path holds, from 1 to 127. A client takes nothing further from the message once a movement gives 0.

bits.name: unusedHigh
bits.note: A client ignores these; a server writes zero.

fields.name: unit
fields.note: The unit the path belongs to. Where a client does not hold it, the movements after it in the group go wrong too; a server sends only units the client holds.

fields.name: teleportToken
fields.note: Tells one relocation from another, as in the compact shape (see spec/movement.md).

fields.name: terms
fields.note: How the unit is made to travel.

fields.name: flags

bits.name: xIsStep
bits.note: Set where this point states its first coordinate as a step.

bits.name: zIsStep
bits.note: Set where this point states its second coordinate as a step.

fields.note: One pair for each point after the first, in the order the points follow. Pairs run on from the low bits of the first byte, and the run reaches to the byte holding the last pair. The bits past it are clear.

fields.name: firstX
fields.note: The first point, along one ground axis, in the units spec/movement.md gives.

fields.name: firstZ
fields.note: The first point, along the other.

fields.name: xStep
fields.note: Added to the first coordinate of the point before, as that point resolved.

fields.name: xWhole
fields.note: The first coordinate, stated without reference to the point before.

fields.name: zStep
fields.note: Added to the second coordinate of the point before, as that point resolved.

fields.name: zWhole
fields.note: The second coordinate, stated without reference to the point before.

revisions.note: A client answers each with WaypointAck, naming this sync id and listing, in order, each unit whose path carried a teleport token with that token.

fields.note: What each unit is told to do.
